comment: Åberg hasn’t gotten much pub in recent weeks, but it’s not for a lack of form: four top-five finishes in his last five starts and the well-rounded game that should thrive at Quail Hollow. Zig while others zag with McIlroy.

The four-time winner will not have to worry about any rust in an event without a 36-hole cut. Did I mention he has won on this course FOUR times? If he can win back-to-back Masters, surely he can successfully defend his 2024 victory (2025 event was played in Philadelphia), right?
I’m subscribing to the McIlroy Masters hangover for a second straight year, so I need to pick the player who I think is the next best option given the moment.
I’ve only got two more chances to use him this segment, which made it a tough decision, but it’s hard to bet against McIlroy at Quail Hollow.
After hitting on captaining Cameron Young last week, comfortably riding the chalk with the two-time Masters champ and a squad full of senders off the tee.
